title: Inspect retained project token usage metadata
limitations: Read-only audit of local usage metadata for threads whose recorded cwd is this repository or a descendant; other machines, worktrees and deleted records were not assessed.

Usage events contain cumulative thread and last-request counters. Disjoint completed-turn accounting and mapping to bounded project sessions have not yet been established, so no usage entries or project token totals were fabricated.
Actual conversation start time, client version and per-turn execution model were not established. Token-event counts are a snapshot of an active client store.

2026-09-24 correction: local client counters recovered for 1 disjoint turns; this supersedes earlier token-unavailability statements for those turns only. Full multi-machine coverage remains unknown. See logs/usage/USAGE-2026-09-24-local.json.

usage.source: 2026-09-24 local token_count recovery; logs/usage/USAGE-2026-09-24-local.json; usage SHA-256 d53ef97a764d1a1920713e4e3b27bb5e99fa8904cfd3987245b6f37ea979fca5; cumulative increases equal last-request counters over persisted turn ordinals 272..334.
limitations: Local client-reported usage only; other-machine coverage and billing equivalence are not established. Per-turn execution model was not reported.

checks.command: Read-only SQLite metadata queries and streaming selection of project token_count events
checks.result: Found 18 local project threads with existing usage records, including 15 recorded child threads; 1724 token-count events with input/output/cached/reasoning fields. Thread creation dates span 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-24. The 37 project logs inspected had no client thread IDs. Persisted turn metadata showed 112 completed, 7 interrupted and 1 in-progress turn. No conversation content was output or retained.

checks.command: python3 tools/session_logging/session_log.py validate && python3 -B tools/dashboard/build.py validate && python3 -B tools/session_logging/session_log.py summary --format json && git diff --check
checks.result: 38 session records and 28 tasks/8 documents/5 review rounds validated. Summary still has no imported token observations. No whitespace errors.
